content: Brazil subscription law: CDC art. 49 grants a 7-day no-questions right of withdrawal (direito de arrependimento) for contracts signed outside a physical establishment (online); within 7 days no fine and full immediate refund. CDC also requires clear, adequate PRIOR information about automatic renewal and about how to cancel - surprise auto-renewal without prior notice is treated as abusive. After 7 days, cancellation any time is allowed; rescission fees only if pre-contracted and non-abusive (jurisprudence caps around 10% of remaining contract value). Continued charging after a cancellation request entitles the consumer to full monetarily-corrected reimbursement. Note: pure B2B is not automatically covered by CDC, but Brazilian courts frequently extend it to small businesses (teoria finalista mitigada), so a micro/small-business SaaS should assume CDC-like obligations.
